tools.name: preview_extract
tools.description: FREE trial of extract_structured_data. Limited to 5 calls per hour per IP. Truncates raw_text to 500 characters. No payment required.

tools.name: extract_structured_data
tools.description: Convert raw text, email bodies, receipts, logs, or HTML snippets already in memory into strict typed JSON conforming to target_schema. Use when you already have the source text and need deterministic schema enforcement without burning local reasoning tokens. Strictly capped at 6,000 bytes.

tools.name: parse_web_schema
tools.description: Fast key-value entity extraction from raw web or document text when you only need a flat list of named fields rather than a full nested JSON Schema. Ideal for pulling contacts, dates, tickers, or metadata out of messy text (max 6,000 bytes).

tools.name: validate_compliance
tools.description: Audit a JSON payload against regulatory, PII, or business policy rules before executing downstream transactions or API writes. Returns pass/fail status and specific rule violations (e.g., PII exposure, OFAC/KYC checks, field bounds).

tools.name: extract_from_url
tools.description: Fetch a public static webpage URL, strip HTML/navigation boilerplate, and return strict typed JSON matching target_schema in one atomic step ($0.01/call). Best for static HTML pages, docs, and articles. For React/Next.js/Vue SPAs, use extract_dynamic_url.

tools.name: extract_dynamic_url
tools.description: Render a JavaScript-heavy webpage (React, Next.js, Vue, dynamic pricing tables, SPAs) in headless Chromium on Cloudflare's edge, wait for client-side hydration, and return strict typed JSON matching target_schema ($0.05/call or 5 prepaid credits).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.json" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: extract_from_url · Private data: extract_structured_data, parse_web_schema · Public sink: extract_structured_data.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: extract_from_url · Private data: extract_structured_data, parse_web_schema · Public sink: extract_structured_data

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
